title: Cypherpunk Citadel DAO
tagline: We aim to create the first online Citadel for the Spanish-speaking world, our DAO focuses on creating content and building community tools to empower the onboarding of the 500 million Spanish speaking people  into the Cryptogenerative Economy.
description: The main scope of our initiative is to produce high-quality content through our weekly spanish streaming, Cypherpunk Nightmares, our YouTube channel where every Friday  we engage with the community and generate an unique POAP that commemorates our meetups. The main functionality of the initial project is to exchange POAPs to an unique token called Citadel (CTDL), that will align our main values and usability in our community DAO.
how_its_made:
This project uses "Third Web", a powerful SDK that let us build Web3 applications right out of the box without using too much code.
https://thirdweb.com/

We also used Polygon Mumbai (testnet) for token generation using test MATIC.

We also used JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS along with wallet integration through the friendly SDKs by Third Web.
In the near future we would like to add integration with Lens Protocol for a social component and Polygon for costless transactions.

Finally, we use Figma to show of the next front end version of the dApp
https://www.figma.com/file/rDf0vUbLcRrdI89KopkO1m/Cypherpunk_Citadel_DAO?node-id=2%3A8
